body.asks: A source brings the world of ones and zeros into the field, but what was once called an integration went both ways: the field may emanate outward, as a REST endpoint from a structure it defines, a file of TypeScript types, a git repository virtualised from its commits. Is the source then two-way, and what is the interface, which integrates to the engine, beside it? The author asks whether, reasoning from integration to source, the historical meaning behind integration was lost, and holds that this is to be revisited before the work moves on.
